lines.en: Establish prayer to remember Me.
Seek help through patience and prayer.
It is a heavy thing, except for the humble.
Prayer restrains from indecency and wrong.
The remembrance of God is greater.
Successful are the believers, those who are humble in their prayer.
Guard the prayers, and stand before God in devotion.
Remember Me, and I will remember you.
Truly in the remembrance of God do hearts find rest.
Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and in the approach of the night.
Good deeds drive away misdeeds.
Prostrate, and draw near.
My prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for God, Lord of the worlds.
Command your family to pray, and be constant in it yourself.
Prayer is prescribed for the believers at appointed times.
Their sides forsake their beds; they call on their Lord in fear and hope.
When My servants ask you about Me, truly I am near.
I answer the call of the caller when he calls on Me.
Call on Me; I will answer you.
Bow down with those who bow.
Glorify your Lord with praise before sunrise and before sunset.
Seek help in patience and prayer; God is with the patient.
So glorify your Lord with praise, and be among those who prostrate.
Keep vigil in part of the night, an offering beyond what is due from you.
Perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station.
The rising of the night is firmest in tread and most upright in speech.
Remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him completely.
Woe to the praying ones who are heedless of their prayer.
So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice.
Remember your Lord within yourself, humbly and in awe, morning and evening.
Do not be among the heedless.
In houses God has allowed to be raised, His name is remembered morning and evening.
Men whom neither trade nor sale distracts from the remembrance of God.
You alone we worship; You alone we ask for help.
The places of prostration belong to God, so call on no one besides God.
Glory to God in your evening hour and in your morning hour.
The recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
Establish prayer from the sun's decline to the darkening of night.
Prosperous is the one who purifies himself, remembers his Lord's name, and prays.
When the prayer is called, hasten to the remembrance of God.
O you who believe, remember God with much remembrance.
Those who remember God standing, sitting, and lying on their sides.
Prostrate to Him, and glorify Him through the long night.
Remember the name of your Lord at morning and evening.
Peace it is, until the rising of dawn.
I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me.
Worship your Lord until certainty comes to you.
Bow, prostrate, and worship your Lord, and do good, that you may prosper.
Say: My Lord would not care for you, were it not for your supplication.
The servants of the Merciful pass the night prostrating and standing.
Our Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and of my descendants too.
Our Lord, accept this from us; You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
Prayer sheds sins as autumn trees shed their leaves.
Prayer unties sins from the neck as tethers are untied.
Prayer is like a spring at your door in which you bathe five times a day.
Prayer is the drawing near of every God-conscious soul.
Some worship in desire, some in fear; the free worship in gratitude.
The first deed a servant is asked about is prayer; if it is accepted, all else is accepted.
Our intercession does not reach one who takes prayer lightly.
Supplication is the weapon of the believer.
God ordained prayer to purify you of pride.
I found You worthy of worship, so I worshipped You.
When you pray, pray the prayer of one bidding farewell.
Of your prayer, only what you offer with an attentive heart is truly yours.
The coolness of my eyes was placed in prayer.
The two rak'ahs of dawn are better than the world and all it contains.
The whole earth was made a place of prostration for me, and its soil pure.
Worship God as though you see Him; if you do not see Him, He surely sees you.
The servant is nearest to his Lord while in prostration.
The one who prays is in intimate conversation with his Lord.
I sit with the one who remembers Me.
Whoever draws near to Me a handspan, I draw near to him an arm's length.
The night prayer makes the face luminous.
lines.source: Imam al-Sadiq, Man la yahduruhu al-Faqih

lines.en: The tasbih of Fatima after each prayer outweighs a thousand extra rak'ahs.
lines.source: Imam al-Sadiq, Man la yahduruhu al-Faqih

lines.en: Prayer keeps the servant from forgetting his Master.
This is a new day, and it will be a witness over us.
Praise belongs to God, the First, without a first before Him.
O He whose name is medicine and whose remembrance is healing.
Strengthen my limbs for Your service.
Grant me complete devotion to You.
Through You I came to know You, and You called me to You.
I call on Him whenever I wish, with no gatekeeper between us.
O He whose remembrance brings honor to those who remember Him.
I bear witness that you established the prayer and gave the alms.
Supplication is the marrow of worship.
Prayer is the ascent of the believer.
Prayer is the pillar of religion.
Everything has a face, and the face of your religion is prayer.
If the one praying knew who he addresses, he would never wish to lift his head.
Prayer is the light of the believer.
Prayer is the key to Paradise.
The key to prayer is purification.
Prayer at its time is among the most beloved of deeds to God.
The first of the prayer's time carries the pleasure of God.
The night prayer is the honor of the believer.
Two light rak'ahs offered with reflection outweigh a night of heedless standing.
No prayer is complete without the presence of the heart.
The mosque is the home of every God-conscious person.
Purity is half of faith.
Wudu upon wudu is light upon light.
